items.title: Google Metrax Brings Predefined Model Evaluation Metrics to JAX
items.summary: Recently open-sourced by Google, Metrax is a JAX library providing standardized, performant metrics implementations for classification, regression, NLP, vision, and audio models. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Decathlon Switches to Polars to Optimize Data Pipelines and Infrastructure Costs
items.summary: Decathlon, one of the world's leading sports retailers, recently shared why it adopted the open source library Polars to optimize its data pipelines. The Decathlon Digital team found that migrating from Apache Spark to Polars for small input datasets provides significant speed and cost savings. By Renato Losio

items.title: Tired of sky-high memory prices? Buckle up, we're in this for the long haul
